changed.note: Replaced datetime.datetime.utcnow() with datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc); unified utcnow() to always return UTC-aware datetimes (removed PYTHON_311 naive branch).
unix_time() uses dt.timestamp() for timezone-aware datetimes so default utcnow() does not subtract against naive epoch.
_not_valid_after/_not_valid_before keep UTC tzinfo for comparison with aware utcnow().
zip2tar timeshift uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) instead of naive datetime.now().
EventSourceMapping last_modified uses utcnow().timestamp() instead of time.mktime(utcnow().timetuple()).
update_event_source_mapping last_modified uses utcnow().timestamp() instead of time.mktime(utcnow().timetuple()).

guesses.assumed: Legacy cryptography without not_valid_after_utc exposes naive not_valid_after; tagging with datetime.timezone.utc matches prior UTC wall-clock semantics.
utcnow().timestamp() matches prior mktime(utcnow().timetuple()) intent (POSIX seconds) more correctly for UTC-aware values.
GraphqlAPIKey/EventsAPIKey default expiry still strips tzinfo after utcnow(); no change required.
ChannelNamespace created/last_modified as aware datetimes are acceptable in API payloads without further changes.
